title: Machine Learning Enabled Structure-Based Drug Repurposing Approach to Identify Potential CYP1B1 Inhibitors.
summary: Four selected compounds were assayed; three inhibited CYP1B1. Enzyme inhibition supports repurposing leads, not clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Support vector machine, random forest and artificial neural network screening
organization: Punjabi University; Guru Nanak Dev University
